content: Omusengero gwa Habakuki n’ishuzo lya Nnâmahanga
Ogu gwo musengero omulêbi Habakuki ayêrekezagya Nnâmahanga guli nka kulaka mulenge

content.text: Yâgirwa, Nyakasane, nayumvîrhe bashambâla emikolo yâwe y’okurhangâza nieshi nayunjula bwôba.
Mwa gano mango g’akalamo kîrhu oshub’izûsa emikolo ya bene eyo, oyimanyîse oku bantu.
Ciru akabà mpu ogwêrhe ecirhumire wakunira, oshub’irhuyêrekeza olukogo lwâwe.
Nyamuzinda ayishire kurhenga e Temani,
Nyamuzinda Mwimâna ayishire ebwa ntondo za Parani.
Obukuze bwâge bubwikire amalunga,
n’igulu lyoshi liyunjwîre irenge lyâge.
Ayishire amoleka n’obulangashane,
emyonzi y’obulangashane edwîrhe yarhenga omu maboko gâge,
mwo obuhashe bwâge bucîfulika.
Ecihûsi cimushokolire, endwâla zimugumire omu cirali.

content: Akayimanga, igulu linadirhimane, amâlola oku mashanja gamâgeramwo ogwa nyugunyu. Entondo z’ensiku n’amango zamârhembagana, orhurhondo rhwa mîra rhwahahanyusire, zo zàli njira akâg’igeramwo burhanzi.

content.text: Nabwîne amalibuko g’abantu b’e Kushani,
n’ecôbà c’abantu bayûbaka e Madiyani
Ka nyîshi Nyakasane, ka nyîshi zirhumire wakunira?
Ka nyanja erhumire omutula gwâwe gudubuka.
Wamâshonera oku bitù nka kuno ojà oku ngâlè edwîrhwe n’ebiterusi byakuhêka ebwa kuhimana.
Wamâgoka omuherho gwâwe, olugè lwâgwo olubumbire bisonga, zo ndahiro w’ebinwa byâwe: lgulu lyafûnuka n’enyîshi zahulula.
Erhi entondo zikubona, zanajuguma, enkuba y’ecihonzi yayunjuza igulu, enyanja nênênè yakûngula n’empimbi z’omulaba zakaz’ilwîra emalunga.
Igulu n’omwêzi byamayimanzibwa n’obumoleke bw’emyampi yâwe yajà yabalala, bilibisire embere ly’okulangashana kw’itumu lyâwe.
Omu burhè bwâwe igulu walilabarha, n’amashanja wagahinaga omu bukunizi bwâwe.
Wahulusire mpu oj’ifungira olubaga lwâwe, n’okufungira Omushîgwa wâwe, washâba oburhungiri bw’enyumpa y’omubî, wayikundula eciriba coshi kuhika oku mabuye
Amatumu gâwe garhulungula amarhwe g’entwâli zâge, ezaliyishire mpu zirhushandabanye n’orhuhababo rhw’omwîshingo nka rhwa bantu balonza okuyîrha omukenyi bwifulikwè.
Enyanja haguma n’empimbi zâyo z’emilaba, wayilabarha n’ebiterusi byâwe.

Nayumvîrhe okwo, obulà bwâni bwajuguma, eryo izù lyarhuma akanwa kandirhimana; akafinjo kangera omu rhuvuha, obwôba bwantwa enjingo z’amagulu. Ndwîrhage nalingûza n’omwîshingo olwo lusiku lw’ebihamba, olwâyishira ishanja likaz’irhulibuza.
Bulya omulehe gurhâciyâse, omuzâbîbu gurhâcijekwo malehe. Omuzêti gwâkaz’ileheka burhaleheka, amashwa garhâcibonekanemwo biryo. Ebyôgo byâhwamwo ebibuzi, ntà nkâfu zâcibonekana ebulambo.
Ci kwône niehe nahama n’omwîshingo muli Nyakasane, nâcîshingira muli Nyamuzinda Muyôkozi wâni.
Nyakasane Nyamuzinda, ye misî yâni, ye mpà okubiduha nka mbogo, ye ngeza ahalengerîre. Oku mukulu w’abimbiza
. Oku nzihwa y’okusalikwa y’emirya.
